sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Tension, as if bound; better, sitting and go-
ing out. Externally sensitive. Headache ceases while
eating. Trembling and throbbing. Pain in heart; ex-
tends to head. Inspired air feels cold.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Half vision; invisible right half. Photophobia.
Pain over eyes. Dry lids.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Acidity, nausea, gnaiving, relieved by eat-
ing. [Anacard.] Cannot endure slightest pressure of
clothes. [Laf/ir<r.]

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Tenesmus. 1 urbid urine, with mucus and
red deposit. Pain in region of right kidney. Free and
colorless. While urinating, pressure in heart. Cystitis,
subacute and chronic.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Constriction of chest. Violent cough
when lying down. Air feels cold when inspired. Pain
in mammary glands, which extend into the arms and
fingers.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Rheumatic soreness in cardiac region.
Sudden shock in heart. Throbbing, dull stitch in car-
diac region. Pains in heart before menses, and asso-
ciated with pains in bladder, and before and after
urinating. Trembling and fluttering in heart, extending
to back.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Paralytic stiffness all over. Itching
about joints. Rheumatic pains throughout shoulder-
joint, arm, and fingers. Pain in hollow of foot, extend-
ing to knee. Swelling and tenderness of finger and toe
joints; better, hot water. Nodular swellings in joints.
Ankles pain when walking.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Scabby, tettery eruption on hands, head, and
^'heeks, preceded by red raw skin. Dull stitch, ending
in itching.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, in morning, right side. Better,
rising and moving about.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Lye.; Ammon, phos.; Bene,
ac.; Calc.; Lithium chlor. (symptoms of cinchonism,
viz. : Dieey head, full, blurring of vision. Ringing in
ears; marked tremors; general weakness; marked mus-
cular and general prostration; no gastro-intestinal ef-
fects. Nose sore, heartburn, pain in teeth). Lithium
lacticum (rheumatism of shoulder, and small joints re-
lieved by moving about; worse, resting). Lithium ben-
coicum (deep-seated pains in loins; in small of back;
uneasiness in bladder, frequent desire. Diminishing
uric acid deposit).
